* basic domain parameters for an Elliptic Curve public or private key.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public ECCurve getCurve()
methods.comment:
* return the curve along which the base point lies.
     * @return the curve

methods.name: public ECPoint getG()
methods.comment:
* return the base point we are using for these domain parameters.
     * @return the base point.

methods.name: public BigInteger getN()
methods.comment:
* return the order N of G
     * @return the order

methods.name: public BigInteger getH()
methods.comment:
* return the cofactor H to the order of G.
     * @return the cofactor

methods.name: public byte[] getSeed()
methods.comment:
* return the seed used to generate this curve (if available).
     * @return the random seed
